description.text: The seventh expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 1 June 2018, with Rayquaza-GX on the wrapper. Rayquaza-GX hits harder the more basic Grass and Lightning Energy its player's Pokémon have, and its GX attack discards its player's hand to draw ten cards. Most of the set's Pokémon come from the Hoenn region; Stakataka-GX, Altaria-GX, Blaziken-GX and Shiftry-GX join Rayquaza-GX, with Prism Star Jirachi, Latias and Latios and the Supporter Steven's Resolve. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 96, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Steven's Resolve, Tate & Liza and Lisia, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Acro Bike, Rainbow Brush and Hustle Belt. In English many of its cards came out in Celestial Storm in August 2018.
